description: Read or change one page on a Lamoi site (an address on s.lamoi.fi). Use this for homepage and page text. Do not use oma_wp_* and do not list hosting services. action get reads pageId. action update (confirm) sets title and/or content. action create (confirm) saves a draft. action publish, unpublish or delete (confirm). action front (confirm) makes pageId the homepage. A plain sentence is stored as a paragraph. Menus, images, SEO and undo are oma_waas_edit. serviceId comes from oma_waas_sites.

action.description: get reads a page. update, create, publish, unpublish and front need confirm.

content.description: Page body. A plain sentence is saved as a paragraph.

pageId.description: Page id from oma_waas_site get. Required except for create.

serviceId.description: The Lamoi site's service id (from oma_waas_sites).

name: oma_waas_page
title: Edit a Lamoi page
